Contributing to building a centralized semantic layer in Databricks
Implementing and maintaining core business metrics, logic and KPIs
Ensuring data quality through automated testing and validation
Documenting datasets and making them easy to find and use

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensuring data quality through automated testing and validation
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Accuracy, trust, testing and documentation recur throughout ("Ensuring data quality through automated testing and validation", "high standards for accuracy") with only one generic "dynamic environment" and no shipping-speed language, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Implementing and maintaining core business metrics, logic and KPIs
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A luxury fashion house where errors affect business metrics and KPIs, with no financial-reporting or regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Contributing to building a centralized semantic layer in Databricks
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A Databricks lakehouse with a gold layer and a Data Insights manager already exists and the role extends it ("Contributing to building a centralized semantic layer in Databricks"), a growing mid-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Designing and maintaining dimensional models (facts, dimensions, lookups) in the gold layer, following star schema principles... Structuring and exposing data for consumption by Power BI and external systems such as Centric and Dema
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name the gold layer, star schema, PySpark on Databricks and the specific downstream systems Centric and Dema, so the daily work is clear.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Your work enables self-service analytics through Power BI and other consumption layers
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is data consumers across the company served through a self-service modelling layer ("enables self-service analytics through Power BI"), an internal-data orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Contributing to building a centralized semantic layer in Databricks... Supporting analysts working in Power BI
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs are build, maintain, contribute and support, with a service-minded framing and no define/lead/set-strategy language, so execution.
evidence.ai_role: Familiarity with AI-assisted Lakehouse tools (code assistants, Genie spaces, AI/BI dashboards, model serving endpoints)
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to be familiar with AI code assistants and Databricks AI tooling as part of their own work, an ai_user signal in requirements only.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensuring data quality through automated testing and validation
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality through automated testing is a responsibility bullet the candidate owns, not just a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: You succeed when datasets are accurate and trusted, and when metrics are consistent across the company
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and accuracy define success in the role summary ("accurate and trusted", "trusted datasets"), so the dominant fear is untrusted data reaching business users: high.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: build the data foundation that turns raw, validated data into business-ready models
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role builds the foundation and a new semantic layer while also maintaining and operating existing models and pipelines ("Designing and maintaining", "Building and operating"), so mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: You succeed when datasets are accurate and trusted, and when metrics are consistent across the company — trust in the data is the role's success measure.
